New Altcoin Mutuum Finance Surges Amid Volatility
Mutuum Finance is gaining momentum, raising $1.8 million in its presale as Dogecoin and Chainlink struggle. Experts predict strong growth potential for MUTM, backed by its innovative lending platform and solid investor support.

Crypto whales are accumulating Dogecoin (DOGE) and the AI-driven FloppyPepe, signaling potential breakouts. DOGE has surged 2.47% in 24 hours, boosted by whale activity and a recent U.S. Department of Government Efficiency announcement, pushing the price up by 15%.
